historical_references.reference: Sideeq Ibn Al-Ash'ath Al-Thaqafi was a famous Arab poet and warrior from the tribe of Ta'amim in the pre-Islamic era, before the advent of Islam. He was known for his bravery and eloquence. He was the leader of the Arab army of the Sassanid Emperor Yazdegerd III against the invading Byzantine forces in 623 AD. In the Battle of Al-Qadisiyyah, Sideeq and his army defeated the Byzantines, paving the way for the Islamic conquest of the Middle East.
